curation: Qubit-curated subset of the upstream pinned plugin index. Every entry is a real remote plugin source pinned to a full 40-character commit SHA; no entry is fabricated. Served display fields (name/label/description/repo/homepage/maintainer) are de-branded product surface; the verbatim upstream identity (name/repo/ref/author) is preserved only in the internal `provenance` sub-field, never rendered as product copy.
install_policy: curated-and-pinned; raw unvetted remote fetch stays refused. An entry install is confirm/audit/e-stop gated and operator-verified at the pinned ref before any repository is fetched.
license_note: Licenses are not carried by the source index and are not fetched with it; `license` is `unverified` until an operator verifies the license at the pinned commit before install.
